option_relations.rationale: Subungual melanoma is a malignant tumor of melanocytes under the nail, while subungual hematoma is a collection of blood under the nail. They are distinct conditions.

Longitudinal melanonychia refers to a pigmented band in the nail, which can be caused by various conditions including melanoma or benign nevi. Subungual hematoma is a collection of blood under the nail. They are distinct conditions.
Onychomatricoma is a benign tumor of the nail matrix. Subungual hematoma is a collection of blood under the nail. They are distinct conditions.
Pigmented onychomatricoma is a variant of onychomatricoma with pigmentation. Subungual hematoma is a collection of blood under the nail. They are distinct conditions.
